title: In the academic world we are fighting hard to be able to share and archive pre-draft versions on our own websites or repos. Taken years, if not decade
summary: In the academic world we are fighting hard to be able to share and archive pre-draft versions on our own websites or repos. Taken years, if not decades, and we are not as vulnerable as journalist. Still might be something to fight for in contracts.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
In the academic world we are fighting hard to be able to share and archive pre-draft versions on our own websites or repos.

Taken years, if not decades, and we are not as vulnerable as journalist.

Still might be something to fight for in contracts.
